purpose: Every admissible emission has a cycle model so function costs can reduce to fixed, ranged, symbolic, or unbounded cycle totals.

modelKinds.expression: symbolic cycle expression using named profile parameters
modelKinds.unbounded: blocking operation with no finite upper cycle bound

aggregation.staticSerial: Sum each executed emission's cycle model. Range values sum bounds. Expression values remain symbolic until cache/branch/runtime parameters are selected.
aggregation.branches: Count only the executed path. Add BRANCH_MISPREDICT when a modeled branch is mispredicted.
aggregation.loops: Multiply body cost by executed iteration count; retain symbolic counts when unknown.
aggregation.calls: Add callee cost plus call/return cost once those forms are qualified.
aggregation.memory: Evaluate LD32/ST32 using an explicit cache scenario; report hot-L1 and hot-L2 totals separately.
aggregation.laterRefinement: Assembly dependency/port analysis may refine the static serial estimate; static sums are a comparable accounting metric, not a wall-clock promise.

/.note: IDIV32 core; surviving JavaScript guards are added after assembly qualification.

%.note: Remainder from integer divide core; surviving JavaScript guards are added after assembly qualification.

**.note: No stable single-instruction mapping; symbolic until emitted implementation is qualified.

--.note: DEC/SUB-by-one ALU class; exact V8 form pending.

&.note: 32-bit AND ALU class; exact V8 form still to be captured.

|.note: 32-bit OR ALU class; exact V8 form still to be captured.

^.note: 32-bit XOR ALU class; exact V8 form still to be captured.

~.note: 32-bit NOT/XOR-mask ALU class; exact V8 form pending.

>>.note: Fixed-count signed shift class; exact V8 form pending.

===.note: CMP/TEST is 1 cycle; Boolean materialization may add one cycle.

!==.note: CMP/TEST is 1 cycle; Boolean materialization may add one cycle.

<.note: CMP is 1 cycle; materialized Boolean may add one cycle.

<=.note: CMP is 1 cycle; materialized Boolean may add one cycle.

>.note: CMP is 1 cycle; materialized Boolean may add one cycle.

>=.note: CMP is 1 cycle; materialized Boolean may add one cycle.

&&.note: Operator overhead only; operands counted separately and only executed RHS included.

||.note: Operator overhead only; operands counted separately and only executed RHS included.

?:.note: Selection/control overhead; selected body counted separately.

CONST32.note: Immediate may fold into consuming instruction; otherwise one materialization operation.

LD32.note: Zen 3: L1D=4, L2=12, L3≈47 cycles; DRAM remains frequency/memory-system dependent.

ST32.note: 0.5-cycle simple-store throughput for local/hot line; ownership/coherence added separately.

ADDR.note: Simple address/LEA near 1 cycle; complex indexed forms can cost 2-3 on Zen 3.

BRANCH.note: Static baseline one cycle plus 15-19 cycle Zen 3 mispredict penalty.

JUMP.note: Static accounting unit for an executed unconditional transfer; frontend effects can overlap.

Math.floor.note: Proven uint32/integral path is semantically redundant; floating path pending.

Math.trunc.note: Proven uint32/integral path is semantically redundant; floating path pending.

Math.ceil.note: Proven uint32/integral path is semantically redundant; floating path pending.

Math.round.note: Proven uint32/integral path is semantically redundant; floating path pending.

Math.min.note: Native min/compare stage is 1-cycle class; JS NaN/signed-zero semantics may add work.

Math.max.note: Native max/compare stage is 1-cycle class; JS NaN/signed-zero semantics may add work.

=.note: Register move may be eliminated; memory assignment uses store model.

??.note: Nullish test/control overhead; operand/access costs counted separately.

?..note: Nullish test plus guarded property/index access.

instanceof.note: At least one type/prototype check; scales with optimized path/prototype depth.

typeof.note: Type-tag discrimination; exact emitted sequence pending.

void.note: No extra work when result is discarded; operand evaluation counted separately.

Atomics.load.note: Sequentially consistent shared load; cache/coherence state included.

Atomics.store.note: Sequentially consistent shared store; ownership/coherence state included.

Atomics.compareExchange.note: Uncontended Zen 3 locked CMPXCHG reference; contention may exceed.

Atomics.exchange.note: Uncontended Zen 3 XCHG reference; contention may exceed.

Atomics.add.note: Uncontended locked XADD reference; cache migration/contention may exceed.

Atomics.sub.note: Provisional locked arithmetic RMW class; exact V8 form pending.

Atomics.wait.note: No finite upper cycle bound; split active CPU cycles from blocked elapsed cycles.

Atomics.notify.note: Wake cost depends on waiters, runtime path, scheduler and OS.

Uint32Array.construct.note: Authoritative cost comes from NEES. Includes view/object creation, backing-store allocation, zero initialization/zero-page provisioning, GC/external-memory accounting, and page commitment/fault effects.

parentCostAuthority.rule: NEES cost profiles override this snapshot
